import json

with open('manifest.json') as f:
    m = json.load(f)

# Extract model info
print('=== MODELS ===')
for k, v in m.get('nodes', {}).items():
    if v.get('resource_type') in ('model', 'test'):
        mat = v.get('config', {}).get('materialized', '')
        rel = v.get('relation_name', '')
        uk = v.get('config', {}).get('unique_key', '')
        cb = v.get('config', {}).get('cluster_by', '')
        lang = v.get('language', 'sql')
        deps = v.get('depends_on', {}).get('nodes', [])
        ofp = v.get('original_file_path', '')
        print(f'{k}|{mat}|{rel}|{uk}|{cb}|{lang}|{ofp}|{deps}')

print()
print('=== SOURCES ===')
for k, v in m.get('sources', {}).items():
    rel = v.get('relation_name', '')
    print(f'{k}|{rel}')

print()
print('=== CHILD MAP (top entries) ===')
cm = m.get('child_map', {})
for k, children in cm.items():
    if children:
        print(f'{k} -> {children}')

print()
print('=== EXPOSURES ===')
for k, v in m.get('exposures', {}).items():
    print(f'{k}|{v.get(\"depends_on\", {})}')
"
